sloka: चतुर्द्वाराणि सर्वाणि सुग्रीववचनात् कपिः ।पर्यक्रामत दुर्धर्षो नक्षत्राणीव चन्द्रमाः ।। ६.४१.९४ ।।।।
transliteration: caturdvārāṇi sarvāṇi sugrīvavacanāt kapiḥ ।paryakrāmata durdharṣo nakṣatrāṇīva candramāḥ ।। 6.41.94 ।।।।

translations.english: Delighted by the roaring sound of many monkeys Rama awaited surrounded by groups of monkeys desirous of starting war.
